title: fix(npm-resolver): strip default port from tarball URLs in lockfile (pnpm/pnpm#15539)
body: ## Summary When an npm registry returns package metadata with tarball URLs containing explicit default ports (e.g. `https://registry.npmjs.org:443/...` or `http://registry.example.com:80/...`), pacquet previously retained the default port in `picked_tarball_resolution`. This caused the lockfile to retain explicit `:443` or `:80` ports, and prevented canonical registry tarballs from being recognized as rebuildable without an explicit tarball URL entry. This PR normalizes tarball URLs during resolution by stripping the default port (`:443` for HTTPS and `:80` for HTTP), matching pnpm v11 behavior (recovering the fix from pnpm/pnpm#10273). Fixes pnpm/pnpm#15539 ## Squash Commit Body ``` When an npm registry serves package metadata with tarball URLs containing explicit default ports (`:443` for HTTPS or `:80` for HTTP), normalize the tarball URL by stripping the default port before saving it to the lockfile. This aligns pnpm v12 with v11 and recovers the fix from pnpm/pnpm#10273. Fixes pnpm/pnpm#15539 ``` ## Checklist - [x] I checked the referenced issue and verified that none of the PRs already linked to it solves it. - [x] New features are implemented only in the Rust pnpm v12 CLI. Bug fixes are implemented in every affected version. - [x] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this PR changes any published package. - [x] Added or updated tests. --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Lockfile tarball URLs now omit default HTTP and HTTPS ports (`:80` and `:443`), keeping equivalent URLs consistent. * Non-default ports remain unchanged, and URLs that cannot be parsed are preserved as provided. * Package installation with lockfile-only mode now records tarball URLs without an explicit HTTPS default port.
